description:
The KML-340 Glycated Hemoglobin Analyzer is widely recognized as a Gold Standard to monitor diabetes, which can indicate the average plasma glucose concentration over 8~12 weeks. Using High Pressure Ion-Exchange HPLC methodology, the KML-340 delivers great accuracy and excellent precision with CV≤2%.

KEMENKES RI AKL 20101621266

Key Features

  • International Diabetes Gold Standard
  • Key Column & buffers for all mode testing
  • High efficiency for HbA1c/Thalassaemia
  • Hb Variant detection of Thalassemia

Easy Operation

  • Automatic Identification of Sample Type
  • Whole blood: 5μL
  • Loading 10 samples at a time, can be continuous loading
  • Built-in Barcode Scanner for Sample Identification
  • Automatic Cap Piercing
  • Customized Laboratory Report
  • PC software with Curve for official Report
  • Online Alarm message for Buffer insufficient
  • Same Reagent Three Test Modes — No additional reagents are required to switch variant test modes
  • Hb-Variant detection: HbD, HbS, HbC, HbE, HbJ, etc.

High Standards for Quality Results

  • Global Standard — Gold Standard to monitor diabetes
  • NGSP & IFCC unit Results — Lyophilized calibrators and quality control materials allow for long shelf life and easy transportation
  • High stability pump to ensure the Hemoglobin separation ensure a constant liquid velocity that gives high precision result
  • High-precision LED detector can detect sample absorbance with high resolution and accuracy

One Step Operation

No pretreatment, hemolysin added and result printed automatically. Simply: Take Blood Sample → Place on Sample Disc → Test and Print out the Results.
specification:
MethodologyHigh Pressure Ion-exchange Liquid Chromatography (HPLC)
InstrumentFully-Auto Glycated Hemoglobin HbA1c Analyzer
Sample TypeVenous Blood, Finger Peripheral Blood, or Hemolyzed Blood
Sample Volume5μl Whole Blood, or Lyse Blood (Ratio 5μl : 1500 μl)
Sample Rack10 Positions, Available for Primary Tube and Sample Cups
Test Mode & SpeedFast mode: 75 Secs/Test
Variant mode: 100 Secs/Test
β-Thalassemia (A2/F) Mode: 240 Secs/Test
Measurement RangeHbA1c: 3-25%, HbF: 0.3-45%, HbA2: 0-15%
PrecisionCV≤2%
ParameterNGSP, IFCC Result
HbA1c, A1a HbF, LA1c, A1c (stable A1c), A1
HbA2, Hb variants (S, C, D, E, J...)
Photometer415nm LED, 20,000 hours life span
Column Capacity4,000 tests, Up to 10,000 tests
Pre-sieve300 tests
InputBuilt-in Barcode Scanner or Touch Keyboard
Display10.4" TFT Colorful LCD Touch Screen
Storage50,000 Test Results or 7,500 Results with Curves
Reagents KitBuffer A, Buffer B, Buffer C (Variant Mode), Hemolysis, Chromatography Column, Control, Calibrator
PrinterThermal Printer or External Printer
Data TransferUSB port, Support LIS/HIS, Independent PC Software
Work ConditionTemperature 5~38°C, Humidity 30%~70%
Power Supply110v~220v, 50-60Hz
Dimension310mm × 470mm × 500mm
Weight20 kgs
